verdict.rationale: The docs say the App API is used to 'fetch data' (outside data-out integrations), and the MCP server and CLI give read access to workspace data. That suggests programmatic read access, but nothing in the pack specifically documents per-person message history (sent, opened, clicked) through the API. missing for 10: an explicitly documented per-person activity or message-history endpoint, coverage of sent/opened/clicked metrics per contact, and any hands-on or independent confirmation that engagement history can be retrieved per contact.
